title: 人工性首次测试：面向超智能的LLM参照C测试
summary: 本文提出首个以LLM作为表征机器的Levin Kt测试，通过逆问题生成高难度测试项，难度以比特为比例尺度衡量，可超越人类和前沿模型能力。研究形式化了度量方法，设计了轻量级生成与认证流程，并对十二个LLM进行了测试，得到随难度下降的智能体特征曲线，直至超智能窗口。
summary_en: This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. The authors formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, and administer a first battery of certified items to twelve LLMs, yielding agent characteristic curves that decrease with difficulty down to the supra-intelligence window.
